newsitem.title: UK: Dlr sets fresh highs in Europe,G7 seen unperturbed.
newsitem.headline: Dlr sets fresh highs in Europe,G7 seen unperturbed.

text.p: The dollar stormed to its highest level here in more than 2-1/2 years against the German mark and almost four years against the yen as U.S., European and Japanese authorities appeared to give its recent rally a green light.

The U.S. unit succumbed to some mild profit-taking later in the day as U.S. stocks and bonds also pared some of their recent gains. Bundesbank member Ernst Welteke also help keep a lid on it as he cautioned about the pace of recent mark depreciation.
However, analysts remained bullish on the dollar outlook against European currencies in particular.
